title: Bootstrap Fashion
description: A responsive fashion retail front end: homepage, category listing with live filters, product page with gallery and reviews, cart, a three-step checkout, and the account screens. Built on Bootstrap 5, so it restyles quickly to a brand and integrates with any commerce backend. Front end only — nothing here is wired to a shop.
highlights: Ten pages, including the full checkout flow
Category filters, price slider and product gallery already built
Bootstrap 5 under it, so brand colours and type are a variables change
Static pages — drop them onto any commerce backend

credit.name: Pixel Rocket
credit.note: A third-party template, shown as a starting point we customise — not as our own build.
